# Integral theorems

The divergence theorem, Stokes' theorem, orientations, regularity assumptions,
and Green's first identity are stated and explained in
[calculus, fluxes, and conservation](operators.qmd#integration-jacobians-and-integral-theorems).
Their conservative PDE consequence is derived in
[the balance-law section](operators.qmd#from-a-balance-law-to-a-pde).
The closed-sphere specialization is in
[surface integration by parts](spherical.qmd#regularity-streamfunction-and-the-closed-surface).
